mapper.select: select count(*) from information_schema.tables where table_schema = current_schema() and table_name = #{tableName}

select c.column_name, col_description( to_regclass(quote_ident(c.table_schema) || '.' || quote_ident(c.table_name)), c.ordinal_position ) as column_comment, c.data_type, (c.is_nullable = 'YES') as nullable_flag, case when pk.column_name is not null then 'PRI' else '' end as column_key, case when c.is_identity = 'YES' then 'auto_increment' when c.column_default like 'nextval(%' then 'auto_increment' else '' end as extra from information_schema.columns c left join ( select kcu.table_schema, kcu.table_name, kcu.column_name from information_schema.table_constraints tc join information_schema.key_column_usage kcu on kcu.constraint_name = tc.constraint_name and kcu.table_schema = tc.table_schema where tc.constraint_type = 'PRIMARY KEY' ) pk on pk.table_schema = c.table_schema and pk.table_name = c.table_name and pk.column_name = c.column_name where c.table_schema = current_schema() and c.table_name = #{tableName} order by c.ordinal_position

select t.table_name, obj_description( to_regclass(quote_ident(t.table_schema) || '.' || quote_ident(t.table_name)) ) as table_comment, t_code_generator_config.update_time configTime from information_schema.tables t left join t_code_generator_config on t.table_name = t_code_generator_config.table_name where t.table_schema = current_schema() and t.table_type = 'BASE TABLE'
AND STRPOS(t.table_name, #{queryForm.tableNameKeywords}) > 0
